title: Canonical prompt corpora: lifecycle, permissions, and versioning for eval-driven regressions
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a robust product and operational model for canonical prompt corpora (referred to as 'canonical prompt corpora' to avoid ambiguity) that the Evals system uses as the authoritative "golden" dataset when evaluating model or config changes. The goal is to enable curated prompt sets with: immutable snapshotting, semantic versioning, role-based access controls, per-prompt metadata (owner, tags, expected outputs), signed checksums for auditability, and integration points so regressions triggered by config/model changes can automatically reference the correct corpus version. Deliverables include the data model, permissions model, CLI + Console UX for dataset curation, CI gating for rollouts that cross eval thresholds, and a migration path for existing prompt sets.
acceptance_criteria: There is a JSON schema and storage layout for canonical prompt corpora supporting per-prompt metadata and a single immutable snapshot identifier (e.g., v1.0.3+sha).
Console and CLI flows exist to create, review, and promote corpus snapshots with RBAC enforcement (owners, reviewers, readers).
Evals pipeline can be pointed at a specific corpus snapshot via API/CLI and records checksum and corpus-id in run metadata.
Regression alerts include the corpus snapshot id and diff summary (added/changed/deleted prompts).
CI gating: a model/config change that increases regression count beyond thresholds blocks automated rollout unless acknowledged with a mitigation plan.
tasks: Design data model and immutable snapshot format for prompt corpora
Define RBAC roles and permission matrix for corpus write/review/read
Prototype Console flow for corpus creation, review, and promotion
Add CLI commands for snapshot creation and signing (redwood evals-corpus create/sign)
Integrate corpus-id and checksum into eval run metadata and regression alerts
Create CI pipeline step to compare new evals vs baseline corpus and fail on policy violations
Write migration script to import existing prompt sets and map owners/tags
updates: 2025-01-12: Scoped MVP to support immutable snapshots and basic RBAC (owner/reviewer/reader).
2025-01-20: Engineering spike completed — storage format options evaluated: object-store blobs with sidecar metadata chosen for S3-friendly immutability.
2025-02-03: Design reviewed Console mockups; added explicit review queue and 'promote to canonical' action.
2025-02-14: Security requested signed checksums and audit-log hook — added to acceptance criteria.
2025-02-25: Integration branch opened linking eval-run metadata to corpus snapshot ID (PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2281).
notes: Trade-off: object-store blobs + sidecar metadata chosen to preserve simple immutability and make snapshot retrieval cheap for evals clusters.
Decision: Versioning will use semver-like labels for human readability but rely on SHA checksums for uniqueness and auditability.
Edge case: prompts with non-deterministic expected outputs will be marked with tag 'fuzzy' and excluded from strict regression gates by default.
Operational concern: retention policy needed to avoid unbounded storage growth; propose cold-archive after 18 months for snapshots not referenced by recent rollouts.
